rule: Each proposed marker must combine at least two attributable inputs, publish a formula or decision rubric, carry freshness and confidence metadata, and pass professional review before launch.

professions.label: Homeowner / buyer
markers: Tax, escrow, utilities, insurance and expected maintenance burden.
Revaluation, added assessment, levy trend and seller-to-buyer exposure.
Evidence completeness, Chapter 123 position and filing-window status.
Likely eligible relief minus benefits currently recorded or claimed.
Services, tax burden and market-value context against nearby towns.
Five-year variability across tax, assessment and municipal pressure.
Conflicts among parcel, permit, sale and owner-supplied facts.
Project type, permit value and local assessment behavior.
Selling, buying, financing and tax differences translated into years.
Ranks the next most valuable verified action for this property.

professions.label: Attorney
markers: Open evidence weighted by legal and closing consequence.
Deed chronology gaps, party mismatches and instrument sequence.
Tax-sale, utility, permit and assessment-change signals.
Open permit age, scope and missing certificate exposure.
Recorded controls, known sites and proximity evidence.
Comparable quality, margin, uniformity and outcome priors.
Owner, mailing, deed and business-registration agreement.
Disclosure-sensitive conditions and unresolved public evidence.
Filing and response windows ranked by days and consequence.
Officiality, recency, parcel match and document traceability.

professions.label: Title / closing
markers: Required evidence families found, current and reconciled.
Unexpected deed, mortgage, discharge or assignment order.
Mortgage records without a confidently matched discharge.
Parcel identifiers reconciled across agencies and years.
Age and cadence of every evidence source in the file.
Municipal utility and delinquency indicators requiring confirmation.
Deed notices, easement proxies and regulatory overlays.
Evidence coverage minus unresolved high-severity exceptions.

professions.label: Real estate agent
markers: Issues likely to surprise a buyer or derail negotiations.
Effective burden relative to comparable competing listings.
Asking-price position adjusted for recurring tax burden.
Tax, permit, condition and location signals ranked by likelihood.
Public-record, permit, tax and disclosure preparation score.
Constraint, tax and record issues that narrow the buyer pool.
True tax-cost change between origin and destination.
Highest-value checks before an offer or waiver decision.
Verified features and location advantages with source confidence.
Material changes since the last saved report or conversation.

professions.label: Mortgage lender / broker
markers: Current escrow against projected tax and insurance obligations.
Projected payment change against similar local collateral.
Tax growth and reassessment scenarios against borrower payment.
Agreement among parcel, permit, sale and appraisal inputs.
Flood evidence, elevation context and missing insurance inputs.
Estimated escrow range under municipal reset scenarios.
Suggested reserve based on improvements and local tax rate.
Constraints, tax burden and market depth affecting resale.
Principal, interest, tax, insurance and known recurring costs.

professions.label: Appraiser
markers: Recency, proximity, similarity and verification combined.
Adjusted price variability and outlier burden.
Land/building split deviation from matched parcels.
Consistency of market behavior across inferred boundaries.
Reconciled range with source-specific confidence weights.
Size, age, class and improvement disagreements.
Arm's-length, record completeness and assessor acceptance.
Local price movement between comp and effective dates.
How independent the valuation evidence is from assessment.
Agreement and quality across independent approaches.

professions.label: Contractor / developer
markers: Count, overlap and consequence of mapped constraints.
Local issue-to-certificate timing by project type.
Jurisdiction, environmental and land-use review stack.
Parcel area minus mapped setbacks and constraints.
Improvement value scenario translated into annual tax.
Farmland history, use change and assessed-value difference.
Sewer, water, road and utility evidence gaps.
Missing geology, environmental and historic-use evidence.
Required approvals and likely critical-path dependencies.
Evidence completeness across site, rule and cost layers.

professions.label: Investor / portfolio
markers: Operating return using projected rather than seller tax.
Exposure to shared budget and revaluation events.
Expected tax increase created by planned improvements.
Market depth adjusted for property-specific friction.
Gap between advertised and normalized recurring costs.
Coverage, freshness and conflicts across holdings.
Property tax sensitivity to local levy and base movement.
Acquire, investigate, hold or exit signal with reasons.

professions.label: Municipal professional
markers: Ratio, COD, age and appeal pressure combined.
Ratable mix, growth and concentration stability.
Estimated levy burden transferred off exempt value.
Debt and project schedules translated into levy sensitivity.
Open construction activity and likely future ratables.
Budget growth relative to organic tax-base growth.
Ranks the most material, addressable municipal pressure.
